story:
Why this one matters: Fulham had one point from four. United had four. Sunday's late kick-off at Craven Cottage finished 1-1.

ESPN UK scoreboard: Lisandro Martinez own goal 63', Matheus Cunha 89'. The table after full time: United 1-2-2, 8 8, 5 points. Fulham 0-2-3, 5 8, 2 points, 19th. Tottenham stay 20th on 2, worse goal difference.

Do not print a 1-0. ESPN UK prints the 89th-minute equaliser.
